COPYRIGHT LICENSE AGREEMENT

This Copyright License Agreement (this "Agreement") is made as of November 6, 2026 between Adaeze Okonjo-Whitfield, an individual residing at 74 Elm Hollow Road, Burlington, Vermont 05401 ("Licensor"), and Cattermole Press, Inc., a New York corporation with offices at 240 Hudson Street, 6th Floor, New York, New York 10013 ("Licensee").

RECITALS

A. Licensor is the sole author and copyright owner of the illustrated work titled "Field Notes from the Winter Marsh," registered with the United States Copyright Office as Registration No. VA 2-401-887 (the "Work").

B. Licensee wishes to publish and distribute the Work in the formats and territory described below.

AGREEMENT

1. GRANT OF LICENSE

1.1 Grant. Licensor grants Licensee an exclusive license to reproduce, distribute, publicly display, and create derivative works of the Work in print, ebook, and audiobook formats, in the English language, throughout the United States, Canada, and their respective territories (the "Territory"), for the Term.

1.2 Reservation of Rights. Licensor reserves all rights not expressly granted, including all rights outside the Territory, all rights in languages other than English, all dramatic, film, television, merchandising, and stage rights, and all rights in any work other than the Work. No license is granted under any patent, trademark, or trade secret of Licensor. Licensee acquires no ownership interest in the Work or in the copyright in it.

1.3 Sublicensing. Licensee may sublicense the rights granted in Section 1.1 to a book club, a large-print publisher, or a foreign-language publisher within the Territory, provided each sublicense is in writing, is consistent with this Agreement, and provides Licensor the share of proceeds stated in Section 3.4. Licensee remains responsible for each sublicensee's performance.

2. OWNERSHIP AND MORAL RIGHTS

2.1 Ownership. The Work is and remains the sole and exclusive property of Licensor. This Agreement is a license and not a transfer of copyright ownership, and nothing in it constitutes an assignment of the copyright in the Work.

2.2 Attribution. Licensee shall credit Licensor as the author and illustrator of the Work on the title page, the copyright page, and the cover of each edition, and in all advertising in which any contributor is credited.

2.3 Integrity. Licensee shall not abridge, expurgate, or materially alter the text or illustrations of the Work without Licensor's prior written approval, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. Copy-editing for house style, and correction of typographical errors, do not require approval.

2.4 Copyright Notice and Registration. Licensee shall print a copyright notice in Licensor's name in the form "© 2026 Adaeze Okonjo-Whitfield" in each copy of each edition, and shall register the copyright in each new derivative work in Licensor's name at Licensee's expense.

3. ROYALTIES AND ACCOUNTING

3.1 Advance. Licensee shall pay Licensor a non-refundable advance against royalties of $40,000, payable one-half on execution of this Agreement and one-half on delivery of the final files.

3.2 Print Royalty. Licensee shall pay Licensor ten percent (10%) of the suggested retail price on the first 10,000 copies of the hardcover edition sold, twelve and one-half percent (12.5%) on the next 10,000, and fifteen percent (15%) thereafter; and seven and one-half percent (7.5%) of the suggested retail price on the trade paperback edition.

3.3 Ebook and Audio Royalty. Licensee shall pay Licensor twenty-five percent (25%) of net receipts from ebook sales and twenty-five percent (25%) of net receipts from audiobook sales.

3.4 Sublicense Proceeds. Licensee shall pay Licensor fifty percent (50%) of proceeds from any sublicense granted under Section 1.3.

3.5 Statements and Payment. Licensee shall render semi-annual royalty statements within ninety (90) days after each June 30 and December 31, and shall pay amounts due with each statement. Licensee may withhold a reserve against returns of not more than twenty percent (20%) of royalties for two accounting periods.

3.6 Audit. Licensor may examine Licensee's records relating to the Work once in any twelve (12) month period, on thirty (30) days' notice. If an examination discloses an underpayment of more than five percent (5%), Licensee shall pay the cost of the examination and the underpayment with interest.

4. PUBLICATION

4.1 Obligation to Publish. Licensee shall publish the Work in a first hardcover edition within eighteen (18) months after delivery of the final files. If Licensee fails to do so, Licensor may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice and retain the advance.

4.2 Format and Price. Licensee has sole discretion over the format, design, price, print run, and marketing of each edition, subject to Sections 2.2 and 2.3.

4.3 Out of Print. The Work is out of print when it is unavailable in any English-language edition in the Territory through Licensee's normal channels and fewer than 250 copies are sold in two consecutive accounting periods. On written notice from Licensor that the Work is out of print, Licensee has six (6) months to reissue it; if it does not, the rights granted revert to Licensor.

5. REPRESENTATIONS AND INDEMNITY

5.1 Licensor. Licensor represents that the Work is Licensor's original creation, that Licensor is the sole owner of the copyright in it, that it has not been previously published, and that it contains nothing defamatory or infringing of any third party's rights.

5.2 Licensee. Licensee represents that it has the authority to enter into this Agreement and will publish the Work in accordance with industry standards.

5.3 Indemnity. Licensor shall indemnify and hold harmless Licensee against any claim arising out of a breach of the representations in Section 5.1, provided Licensee gives prompt written notice, permits Licensor to participate in the defense, and does not settle without Licensor's consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. Licensor's aggregate liability under this Section shall not exceed the amounts actually paid to Licensor under this Agreement.

6. TERM AND TERMINATION

6.1 Term. This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for the full term of copyright in the Work, unless terminated earlier (the "Term").

6.2 Termination for Cause. Either party may terminate this Agreement if the other materially breaches it and fails to cure within thirty (30) days after written notice.

6.3 Reversion. On termination or on reversion under Section 4.3, all rights granted revert to Licensor automatically, Licensee shall cease manufacturing copies, and Licensee may sell off existing inventory for six (6) months subject to the royalty obligations. Licensor may purchase remaining inventory at cost.

6.4 Statutory Termination. Nothing in this Agreement waives or limits Licensor's right to terminate the grant under 17 U.S.C. § 203, which cannot be waived by agreement.

6.5 Survival. Sections 2.1, 3.6, 5.3, 6.3, 6.4 and 7 survive termination.

7. GENERAL

7.1 Governing Law; Venue. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. Any action arising out of this Agreement shall be brought in the state or federal courts located in New York County, New York.

7.2 Assignment. Licensee may not assign this Agreement without Licensor's prior written consent, except to a successor to substantially all of its publishing business that assumes this Agreement in writing.

7.3 Notices. All notices shall be in writing and delivered by hand, by nationally recognized overnight courier, or by electronic mail with confirmation of receipt, to the addresses first stated above.

7.4 Entire Agreement; Amendment. This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties and may be amended only in a writing signed by both.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.
